justification: Both are tall upright stone surfaces bearing shallow relief with abstract, non-figural motifs including at least one ring/disc-like form arranged vertically, which is a generic correspondence. A shows an angular, blocky glyph-like cluster with rectilinear framed signs, whereas B shows a large anthropomorphic body with rounded, curvilinear ring-and-arc motifs and a distinct head, so the specific forms, proportions and relationships differ.
